items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Ted Heath even traveled with us... That was when the incident happened in Birmingham, Alabama... And then we had the group with Ted Heath and June Christie and Gary Morton and Nat.

ctx.x: So you were the first group that got to have the whole band play?

Yes ... yeah. So we were -- this was in '54, and then after we came over, I think the next group was Stan Kenton, and they started exchanging, but Ted Heath even traveled with us, with June Christie and the comedian that married Lucille Ball -- that was the comic with us --
